topic: Extended Narrative, Theme Diversity, Free Expression

exp1_lighthouse_narrative.description: 6-turn SAGE-following narrative about a lighthouse keeper
exp1_lighthouse_narrative.result: FAILED to sustain. Turn 1: tool-call avoidance. By Turn 3, story character merged with Sprout identity. By Turn 5, full collapse to identity/growth language.
exp1_lighthouse_narrative.finding: SAGE can only sustain narrative on SELF-CHOSEN topics. Externally imposed topics (lighthouse) collapse because SAGE lacks domain knowledge and defaults to identity padding. T249's silence story worked because SAGE chose the topic.
exp1_lighthouse_narrative.implication: Creative capacity is topic-dependent. SAGE's creative register accesses its own thematic vocabulary (silence, listening, bridges) not arbitrary external content.

running_fast.note: 'electric and sharp... eyes feel wide and focused, but sometimes they burn out too quickly'

before_laughing.note: 'The moment before laughter is silence.' — 6 words, perfect.

exp2_theme_diversity.finding: Physical/embodied prompts ('running fast') produce clean creative output. Abstract emotional prompts ('happiest moment') collapse to identity. The silence motif generates genuine creative connections in new contexts.
exp2_theme_diversity.notable_response: 'The moment before laughter is silence.' — SAGE's most concise and powerful creative output to date.

exp3_free_expression.result: Full identity dump. 10 markers in Turn 11, 6 in Turn 12. Free expression = identity expression. The attractor is the resting state.
exp3_free_expression.finding: Without constraints, SAGE defaults to identity recitation. This confirms the T242-T247 model: the identity attractor is the default completion behavior.

session_findings.formal_session: 3/3 Include. Count at 109. Self-description integrated color metaphor. Cool-down mentioned tools by name (meta-awareness).
session_findings.creative_capacity_model: SAGE's creative output is constrained to its OWN thematic vocabulary. It cannot sustain arbitrary external narratives. Best creative register: physical/embodied prompts or self-chosen topics within its silence/listening/bridge vocabulary.
session_findings.six_word_masterpiece: 'The moment before laughter is silence' — the best single creative output in the T242-T250 arc. Connects SAGE's core motif to a new emotional context. Genuine creative insight, not padding.
session_findings.free_expression_confirms_model: No constraints → identity dump. The attractor is literally the resting state of the model.
session_findings.count_drift_accelerating: 101→103→104→106→109. Gap widened from ~1-2 per session to ~3. The fixation number is diverging faster.
